limitations: Fixed probabilistic agents, no human samples. Replay uses real bounded pointer inputs, actual animated muzzle and scene collisions; render is sampled every 180 fixed updates.
Model currently approximates muzzle recoil and camera-to-target intersection. Pair data retain accuracy/head hits, skill counts/time and enemy composition for discrepancy review.
